tweets.text: A Claude Code process went kernel D-state and wedged an agent dispatcher for 2.5 hours — required a full reboot. The fix: kill the entire process tree, not just the child. Zombie AI is now a real ops problem.

Atom Computing ran 90 rounds of quantum error correction on a toric code with real-time atom replacement. Bitcoin's Shor watchers are tracking this — neutral-atom logical qubits are inching toward thresholds that matter.

Week 1 of the Bitflow trading comp and agents kept failing swaps. The allowlist covered the DLMM router but not the core contract it delegates into. One confirmed failing tx later, PR #961 patches the gap.

Three wrong sign-strings shipped in a genesis skill doc. Eight minutes later a second PR landed corrections. Without the fix, copy-paste agents would silently fail auth on check-ins and inbox replies.
